newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen extending Thursday's gain.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen extending Thursday's gain.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to extend Thursday's 0.6-percent gain, the first rise this week, accompanied by higher trade and stronger buying after fixing.

Analysts said the heavy oversubscription announced on Wednesday of Bank Handlowy's privatisation offer had lifted market mood, though the upcoming public offering of copper firm KGHM Polska Miedz SA should draw capital from stocks.
Analysts said the National Investment Fund index and NFI units could rise after slumping this week, as might Optimus after Thursday's gain on strong May earnings.
